verdict.rationale: Datalab documents conversion of PDFs and other documents into Markdown, JSON, HTML, or chunks, which suits LLM and RAG ingestion. Nothing in the evidence shows it strips repeated headers, footers, or other page furniture. Community hands-on reports also describe intermingled columns and garbled tables in tricky layouts. Missing for 10: documented removal of headers, footers and page furniture; documented LLM-oriented cleanliness of output; independent corroboration of clean output on complex layouts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I get clean markdown/JSON designed for LLM consumption, with noise like repeated headers and page furniture stripped

citations.quote: Convert a PDF, image, or document to markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Datalab provides document intelligence APIs to convert PDFs, spreadsheets, and images into structured, machine-readable outputs.
Marker handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images.
